## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Security-check design

- [ ] Applicability is clear.
- [ ] Evidence criteria are clear.
- [ ] Remediation is minimal and framework-appropriate.
- [ ] Verification is defined.
- [ ] Common false positives are considered.
- [ ] No real secrets/personal data are included.
- [ ] No unauthorized offensive-testing instructions are introduced.

## Validation

- [ ] `bash tests/test-scripts.sh` passes.
- [ ] Documentation/examples were updated if behavior changed.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` was updated when appropriate.
